name: EUR/USD 1.05 Breakdown Analysis with DXY Context
description: Research study analyzing EUR/USD breakdowns below the 1.05 support level with DXY context via UUP (US Dollar ETF). (1) Frequency analysis: how often EURUSD closes below 1.05, percentage of days below, and current streak. (2) Breakdown event study: detects crossunder events below 1.05, computes forward returns at +5d, +10d, +20d, and classifies each breakdown as "held" (still below 1.05 at day 20) or "bounced" (back above by day 20). (3) DXY regime analysis: classifies each breakdown by whether the dollar was "Strong" (UUP above 20-day SMA AND positive 20-day ROC) or "Weakening" at the time, then splits held/bounced counts and forward returns by regime. Includes UUP price chart with 20-day SMA overlay.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD 1.05 BREAKDOWN ANALYSIS WITH DXY CONTEXT
# =============================================================================
# Frequency: How often does EUR/USD close below 1.05?
# Breakdown: What happens after EUR/USD crosses below 1.05 from above?
# Forward windows: +5d, +10d, +20d returns after breakdown
# Classification: "Held" (below 1.05 at day 20) vs "Bounced" (above by day 20)
# DXY Context: Classify dollar regime at breakdown using UUP (above 20-SMA AND pos ROC = Strong)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# UUP REFERENCE DATA (DXY Proxy)
# =============================================================================

uup_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="UUP")()
uup_close = uup_ref.c
uup_sma20 = ma(period=20)(uup_close)
uup_roc20 = roc(period=20)(uup_close)

# DXY regime: "Strong" if UUP above 20-SMA AND positive 20d ROC, else "Weakening"
uup_above_sma = uup_close > uup_sma20
uup_pos_roc = uup_roc20 > 0
dxy_strong = uup_above_sma and uup_pos_roc
dxy_weakening = not dxy_strong

# =============================================================================
# FREQUENCY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================

level = 1.05
is_below = close < level

# Running totals
below_flag = 1.0 if is_below else 0.0
total_below = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(below_flag)
total_days = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Count)(close)
pct_below = total_below / total_days

# Current streak (bidirectional: positive = consecutive below, negative = consecutive above)
streak_val = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.bidirectional)(is_below)

# =============================================================================
# BREAKDOWN DETECTION (crossunder below 1.05)
# =============================================================================

is_breakdown = crossunder(close, level)

breakdown_count_raw = 1.0 if is_breakdown else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS AFTER BREAKDOWN
# =============================================================================

post_5d = ((close << 5) - close) / close
post_10d = ((close << 10) - close) / close
post_20d = ((close << 20) - close) / close

# Price at day 20 to classify held vs bounced
close_at_20d = close << 20
is_held = close_at_20d < level
is_bounced = close_at_20d >= level

# Filter forward returns to breakdown events only
bd_post5 = where(is_breakdown, post_5d)
bd_post10 = where(is_breakdown, post_10d)
bd_post20 = where(is_breakdown, post_20d)

# Held vs bounced subgroups
held_post5 = where(is_breakdown and is_held, post_5d)
held_post10 = where(is_breakdown and is_held, post_10d)
held_post20 = where(is_breakdown and is_held, post_20d)

bounced_post5 = where(is_breakdown and is_bounced, post_5d)
bounced_post10 = where(is_breakdown and is_bounced, post_10d)
bounced_post20 = where(is_breakdown and is_bounced, post_20d)

# Event counts for held/bounced
held_flag = where(is_breakdown, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
bounced_flag = where(is_breakdown, 1.0 if is_bounced else 0.0)

# Entry price at breakdown
entry_price = where(is_breakdown, close)

# =============================================================================
# DXY REGIME SPLIT AT BREAKDOWN
# =============================================================================

# Regime flags at breakdown events
is_bd_strong = is_breakdown and dxy_strong
is_bd_weakening = is_breakdown and dxy_weakening

# Event counts by regime
strong_count = where(is_breakdown, 1.0 if dxy_strong else 0.0)
weak_count = where(is_breakdown, 1.0 if dxy_weakening else 0.0)

# Held/bounced within Strong regime
strong_held_flag = where(is_bd_strong, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
strong_bounced_flag = where(is_bd_strong, 1.0 if is_bounced else 0.0)

# Held/bounced within Weakening regime
weak_held_flag = where(is_bd_weakening, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
weak_bounced_flag = where(is_bd_weakening, 1.0 if is_bounced else 0.0)

# Forward returns by DXY regime
strong_post5 = where(is_bd_strong, post_5d)
strong_post10 = where(is_bd_strong, post_10d)
strong_post20 = where(is_bd_strong, post_20d)

weak_post5 = where(is_bd_weakening, post_5d)
weak_post10 = where(is_bd_weakening, post_10d)
weak_post20 = where(is_bd_weakening, post_20d)

# Hold rate: fraction of breakdowns that held, per regime
strong_held_for_rate = where(is_bd_strong and is_held, 1.0)
weak_held_for_rate = where(is_bd_weakening and is_held, 1.0)

# Event marker data
ev_post5 = where(is_breakdown, post_5d)
ev_post10 = where(is_breakdown, post_10d)
ev_post20 = where(is_breakdown, post_20d)
ev_held = where(is_breakdown, 1.0 if is_held else 0.0)
ev_dxy_regime = where(is_breakdown, 1.0 if dxy_strong else 0.0)
ev_uup_roc = where(is_breakdown, uup_roc20)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Table 1: Frequency & Breakdown Summary ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EUR/USD 1.05 Level Summary',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['EUR/USD vs 1.05'],
        col_headers=['Total Days', 'Closes Below 1.05', '% Below', 'Breakdown Events', 'Current Streak'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Indigo),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Teal)
        ]
    ),
    category='1.05 Level Analysis',
    order=0
)(total_days, total_below, pct_below, breakdown_count_raw, streak_val)

# --- Chart 1: EUR/USD Price with 1.05 Reference Line ---
xy_lines(
    title='EUR/USD Daily Close vs 1.05 Level',
    category='1.05 Level Analysis',
    y_axis_label='EUR/USD',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EUR/USD Close', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=1.05, title='1.05 Level', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(idx, close)

# --- Chart 2: Average Forward Returns by Held vs Bounced (Grouped Bar) ---
xy_bars(
    title='Avg Forward Returns After 1.05 Breakdown: Held vs Bounced',
    category='1.05 Level Analysis',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Held', color=Color.Blue, stack='+5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Bounced', color=Color.Slate, stack='+5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Held', color=Color.Blue, stack='+10d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Bounced', color=Color.Slate, stack='+10d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Held', color=Color.Blue, stack='+20d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Bounced', color=Color.Slate, stack='+20d')
    ]),
    order=2
)(held_post5, bounced_post5, held_post10, bounced_post10, held_post20, bounced_post20)

# --- Table 2: Held vs Bounced Breakdown ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Breakdown Classification & Return Profile',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['All Breakdowns', 'Held (Below at +20d)', 'Bounced (Above at +20d)'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg +5d Return', 'Avg +10d Return', 'Avg +20d Return'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Indigo),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='1.05 Level Analysis',
    order=3
)(breakdown_count_raw, bd_post5, bd_post10, bd_post20, held_flag, held_post5, held_post10, held_post20, bounced_flag, bounced_post5, bounced_post10, bounced_post20)

# --- Table 3: DXY Regime Breakdown ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='DXY Regime Breakdown at Breakdown',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=7,
        row_headers=['DXY Strong/Rising', 'DXY Weakening'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Held', 'Bounced', 'Hold Rate', 'Avg +5d', 'Avg +10d', 'Avg +20d'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Teal),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Teal),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=6, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='DXY Context',
    order=4
)(strong_count, strong_held_flag, strong_bounced_flag, strong_held_for_rate, strong_post5, strong_post10, strong_post20, weak_count, weak_held_flag, weak_bounced_flag, weak_held_for_rate, weak_post5, weak_post10, weak_post20)

# --- Chart 3: UUP Price with 20-day SMA ---
xy_lines(
    title='UUP (Dollar ETF) with 20-Day SMA',
    category='DXY Context',
    y_axis_label='UUP Price',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='UUP Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20-Day SMA', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=5
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(uup_close, uup_sma20))

# --- Event Markers for Breakdown Events (with DXY context) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='1.05 Breakdown',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Entry Price', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=5),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+5d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='+20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Held at +20d (1=Yes)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='DXY Regime (1=Strong, 0=Weak)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='UUP 20d ROC', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(is_breakdown, entry_price, ev_post5, ev_post10, ev_post20, ev_held, ev_dxy_regime, ev_uup_roc)
